notes.subject: מבית לאולם
notes.rationale: KJV 'within the porch' vs YLT 'within the porch' as location vs 'more inward than the porch' (Geneva) — the phrase's spatial sense is disputed.

notes.subject: לבת פרעה
notes.rationale: 'Farawo ka denmuso' — 'denmuso' here means wife (as Hebrew bat can), rendered literally as daughter-shape.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.rationale: Verse describes palace structures and their comparative workmanship — part of the temple precinct measurement/architecture catalogue.

notes.subject: מבית
notes.rationale: Hebrew mibbayit 'from/within the house' folded into the single word 'kɔnɔ'.

translation: Ni a ka so min na a tun bɛna sigi yen, janko wɛrɛ min bɛ ulamdanni kɔnɔ, o dilanna ni baara nimɔrɔ ye i n'a fɔ kɛnɛ in. A dilan fana ye so dɔ Farawo (Faran) ka denmuso la, min taamira Sholomo (Sulumana) ye, i n'a fɔ ulamdanni in ye cogo min ye.

tokens.gloss: a dilan fana ye so dɔ
